request.text:
With those restrictions,
the deduction theorem, Theorem~\ref{thm:p02-hilbert-fol-deduction}, states
that \(\Gamma\cup\{\varphi\}\vdash\psi\) if and only if
\(\Gamma\vdash\varphi\to\psi\).  Its free-variable condition is carried by the
derivability relation itself: Gen and \(\exists E\) may be applied to a line
whose support contains \(\varphi\) only when the variable of the rule is not
free in \(\varphi\).  It is proved in Annex~\ref{annex:p2.fol.calc.5}, with
every case written as a derivation in
Annex~\ref{annex:p02-w02-p02-025-discharge}.
